## Data quality checklist

- [ ] All new files are under `design/<platform>/<product-slug>/` with kebab-case names.
- [ ] Source images preserve the capture pixels and original aspect ratio; no destructive upscaling.
- [ ] Each new image has a matching entry in `tags.json` with accurate **screen** and **UI element** labels.
- [ ] Product category / description / domain metadata are correct and not derived from styling labels.
- [ ] Screenshot dimensions, viewport, capture date, origin and licensing have been documented where applicable.
- [ ] The screenshots contain no private information, credentials, or sensitive personal data.
- [ ] I can explain the rights or licence basis for including each new asset, with a supporting link.
- [ ] I ran the appropriate tests, and the generated catalogue contains no errors.
